meta.source: NHS website medicine pages (nhs.uk); Cefixime from its US FDA label on DailyMed. Each record lists its source_urls.
meta.note: Condensed from the cited pages on 2026-11-03, keeping the source's wording. drug_class and dosage_forms are set by the MedWise BD team. Not medical advice.

records.name: Paracetamol
indications: Symptoms of a cold or flu, such as a high temperature (fever)
side_effects: Side effects are rare when paracetamol is taken at the right dose
Serious (rare): an allergic reaction (anaphylaxis), such as a swollen throat or tongue, an itchy rash or difficulty breathing
Serious (rare): liver problems, such as feeling sick or yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice)
Serious (rare): a problem with blood cells, such as bruising easily and nosebleeds
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction to paracetamol before
May not be suitable if you have a kidney or liver condition
May not be suitable if you're dependent on alcohol or binge drink
If you're pregnant, paracetamol is usually the best painkiller to use

records.name: Ibuprofen
side_effects: Serious (rare): stomach ulcers or bleeding inside the stomach, such as vomiting blood or black, sticky poo
Serious (rare): a kidney problem, such as blood in your pee or swelling in your ankles, feet or hands
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction to ibuprofen, aspirin or another NSAID
May not be suitable if you have a stomach ulcer or have had one before
May not be suitable if you have asthma or allergies (such as hay fever)
May not be suitable if you have a heart, liver or kidney condition
May not be suitable if you have problems with blood clotting or have had a stroke
Avoid ibuprofen during pregnancy unless a doctor or pharmacist advises it

records.name: Aspirin
indications: At a low, regular dose: to prevent blood clots and lower the chance of a heart attack or stroke
side_effects: Bleeding more easily than usual (for example, a cut may take longer to stop bleeding)
Serious (rare): stomach ulcers or bleeding inside the stomach, such as vomiting blood or black, tar-like poo
Serious (rare): shortness of breath or wheezing
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction to aspirin, ibuprofen or another NSAID
May not be suitable if you have a stomach ulcer or have had one before
May not be suitable if you have asthma or heart failure
May not be suitable if you have a liver or kidney condition or problems with blood clotting
Tell your doctor if you're pregnant or get pregnant while taking low-dose aspirin

records.name: Omeprazole
indications: The stomach infection Helicobacter pylori (along with antibiotics)
side_effects: Serious (rare): a very low level of vitamin B12, causing tiredness, dizziness or muscle weakness
Serious (rare): weakened bones, which can break more easily (more likely with long-term use)
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction to omeprazole or another PPI
May not be suitable if you have a kidney or liver condition
May not be suitable if you have osteoporosis (weakened bones)
You can usually take omeprazole if you're pregnant, but check with a pharmacist or doctor first

records.name: Esomeprazole
indications: Indigestion, heartburn and acid reflux, including gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD)
side_effects: Serious (rare): yellow skin or eyes, pale poo or dark pee (possible liver problems)
Serious (rare): diarrhoea that is severe or does not go away
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to esomeprazole or any other medicine
Tell your doctor if you have liver problems
Tell your doctor if you are due to have an endoscopy
Tell your doctor if you are losing weight without trying, are vomiting blood, have blood in your poo or have problems swallowing

records.name: Pantoprazole
indications: Heartburn, acid reflux and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD)
side_effects: Most people have no side effects; uncommon ones include headaches, diarrhoea and feeling or being sick
Serious (rare): joint pain with a red skin rash, especially on skin exposed to the sun
Serious (rare): yellow skin or eyes or dark pee (possible liver problems)
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to pantoprazole or any other medicine
Tell your doctor if you have liver problems or low levels of vitamin B12
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, trying to get pregnant or breastfeeding
Tell your doctor if you are due to have an endoscopy

records.name: Amoxicillin
indications: Bacterial infections, such as chest infections (including pneumonia) and dental abscesses
Ear infections and chest infections in children
side_effects: Serious (rare): diarrhoea that contains blood or mucus, or severe diarrhoea
Serious (rare): yellow skin or eyes, pale poo and dark pee (possible liver problems)
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to amoxicillin or penicillin
Tell your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems
Tell your doctor if you have glandular fever (amoxicillin can cause a rash)
Tell your doctor if you are due to have blood or urine tests or any vaccinations

records.name: Azithromycin
indications: Ear, nose and throat infections such as sinus infections (sinusitis)
side_effects: Changes to your sense of taste
Serious (rare): a faster or irregular heartbeat (arrhythmia)
Serious (rare): yellow skin or eyes, or pale poo with dark pee
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to azithromycin or any other medicine
Tell your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems
Tell your doctor if you have heart problems, including an irregular heartbeat
Tell your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis

records.name: Cefixime
side_effects: Serious (rare): severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis); stop and get help if a reaction occurs
Serious (rare): Clostridioides difficile diarrhoea, which can range from mild diarrhoea to severe colitis
precautions: Do not use if you are allergic to cefixime or other cephalosporins
Use with caution if you are allergic to penicillin (cross-allergy can occur)
Tell your doctor if diarrhoea develops during or after treatment

records.name: Ciprofloxacin
indications: Urinary tract infections (UTIs), such as bladder or kidney infections
side_effects: Serious (rare): damage to tendons, causing sudden joint pain, swelling or difficulty walking
Serious (rare): numbness and tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy)
Serious (rare): seizures (fits) or changes to mood
precautions: Tell your doctor if you've had an allergic reaction or serious side effect from ciprofloxacin or another fluoroquinolone
Tell your doctor if you have diabetes, epilepsy or another nervous system condition
Tell your doctor if you have a heart problem or a kidney condition
Tell your doctor if you have an abdominal aortic aneurysm, or a close relative has had one
Ciprofloxacin is not usually used during pregnancy; tell your doctor if you're pregnant

records.name: Metronidazole
indications: Mouth infections, including infected gums and dental abscesses
side_effects: Feeling or being sick (nausea or vomiting)
A metallic taste in your mouth or a furry tongue
Serious (rare): yellow skin or eyes (possible liver problems)
Serious (rare): severe stomach pain that may reach through to your back (possible pancreatitis)
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to metronidazole or any other medicine
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding
Tell your doctor if you will not be able to stop drinking alcohol while using metronidazole
Tell your doctor if you have liver problems, a nervous system disease or are having dialysis

records.name: Metformin
indications: Type 2 diabetes (on its own or with other diabetes medicines)
Diabetes that develops during pregnancy (gestational diabetes)
side_effects: A change to the way things taste
Serious (rare): vitamin B12 deficiency, which can make you feel very tired
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction or serious side effect from metformin
May not be suitable if you have liver or kidney problems
May not be suitable if you have a severe infection or heart failure
May not be suitable if you drink a lot of alcohol
Tell your doctor if you're pregnant or get pregnant while taking metformin

records.name: Gliclazide
side_effects: Serious (rare): a problem with blood cells, such as bruising easily, a sore throat and a high temperature
Serious (rare): liver problems, such as yellowing of the skin or eyes
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction or serious side effect from gliclazide or a similar medicine
May not be suitable if you have severe kidney or liver disease
May not be suitable if you have acute porphyria
Tell your doctor if you're pregnant or trying to get pregnant

records.name: Amlodipine
side_effects: Swelling in your ankles, feet and legs (oedema)
A red and warm face or neck (flushing)
Serious (rare): swelling of the pancreas (acute pancreatitis), causing sudden severe tummy pain
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction or serious side effect from amlodipine or a similar medicine
May not be suitable if you have low blood pressure or heart failure
May not be suitable if you have had a recent heart attack or have heart valve disease
Tell your doctor if you're pregnant or get pregnant while taking amlodipine

records.name: Losartan
indications: Kidney disease caused by type 2 diabetes
side_effects: Swelling in your legs, ankles or feet (oedema)
Serious (rare): a fast or irregular heartbeat
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction to other ARB medicines
May not be suitable if you have severe heart failure or liver problems
May not be suitable if you've had angioedema (sudden swelling of parts of the body)
Losartan is not usually used during pregnancy; tell your doctor if you're pregnant or trying to get pregnant

records.name: Atorvastatin
indications: Preventing angina, heart attack and stroke in people with cardiovascular disease
side_effects: Digestive problems, such as constipation, diarrhoea or indigestion
Blocked or runny nose, or nosebleeds
Serious (rare): muscle damage, causing cramps, severe pain and weakness
Serious (rare): inflammation of the liver (hepatitis) or pancreas (pancreatitis)
precautions: May not be suitable if you've had an allergic reaction or serious side effect from atorvastatin or another statin
May not be suitable if you have liver or kidney problems, or an underactive thyroid
May not be suitable if you regularly drink a lot of alcohol
Atorvastatin is not recommended during pregnancy because it can affect how the baby develops

records.name: Clopidogrel
indications: Preventing blood clots after a heart attack, unstable angina or a stroke or mini-stroke (TIA)
After an operation on the heart or blood vessels, such as a coronary stent
side_effects: Serious (rare): blood in your pee, or black poo that looks like tar
Serious (rare): yellow skin or eyes (possible liver problems)
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to clopidogrel or any other medicine
Tell your doctor if you have ever had a stomach ulcer or bleeding in your brain
Tell your doctor if you have a bleeding disorder, such as haemophilia
Tell your doctor if you have recently had surgery or a serious injury
Tell your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, or are pregnant or breastfeeding

records.name: Warfarin
indications: Treating and preventing blood clots, including deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism
Reducing the risk of blood clots, for example with atrial fibrillation or a mechanical heart valve
side_effects: The main side effect of warfarin is an increased risk of bleeding
Serious (rare): blood in your pee or poo, unexplained bruising or nosebleeds
Serious (rare): coughing up or vomiting blood
Serious (rare): a sudden bad headache with confusion or slurred speech (possible bleeding in the brain)
precautions: May not be suitable if you're allergic to warfarin
May not be suitable if you have liver or kidney problems or high blood pressure
May not be suitable if you've recently had a stroke or surgery, or are about to have surgery
May not be suitable if you have a condition that makes you bleed more easily, such as a stomach ulcer
Warfarin is not usually used during pregnancy as it can affect the baby's development

records.name: Montelukast
indications: Seasonal allergies, such as sneezing and itchiness
side_effects: Serious (rare): mood changes, such as becoming anxious, depressed or aggressive
Serious (rare): seeing things that are not there (hallucinations)
Serious (rare): new or worse sleep problems, such as nightmares
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to montelukast or any other medicine
Tell your doctor if you have a rare hereditary problem of galactose intolerance
Do not use montelukast to treat an asthma attack; use a reliever inhaler

records.name: Cetirizine
indications: Reactions to insect bites and stings
side_effects: Sneezing or blocked and runny nose
Serious (rare): a serious allergic reaction (anaphylaxis), such as sudden swelling of the lips, mouth or throat
precautions: Tell your doctor if you have ever had an allergic reaction to cetirizine or any other medicine
Tell your doctor if you have kidney failure
Tell your doctor if you have epilepsy or are at risk of seizures
Tell your doctor if you have difficulty peeing
Tell your doctor if you are due to have an allergy test
